title: Version Changelog - 2025
body_markdown:
[Link to Changelog - 2026](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog)


## v1.82.4​


*December 30, 2025*


- Improve onboarding experiences.
- Fix an issue where Gemini models might not search web content when the Space option is enabled in a chat.


## v1.82.3​


*December 29, 2025*


- Support auto-suggested questions when importing content using the "Research a topic" button. (You can enable this feature in Settings > AI features > AI suggested questions.)
- Support customizing your preferred AI output languages in the AI chat.
- Add more output languages in the default AI actions.
- Improve the behavior when pressing backspace after a quote block
- Fix an issue where some public shared whiteboards are incorrectly accessed by collaborators.


## v1.82.2​


*December 27, 2025*


- Fix an issue where the connect button at the top right of a card might not work.


## v1.82.1​


*December 26, 2025*


- Move the address bar from the top left sidebar to the top of the web tabs.


## Mobile app v1.32.4.1​


- You can now pinch or double-tap to zoom in on a PDF card.


## v1.82.0​


*December 26, 2025*


- Whiteboard: AI action for cards


- Remove the GPT-4.1 model.
- Refine the Tag app's design.


## v1.81.5​


*December 22, 2025*


- Improve onboarding experience.


## Mobile app v1.32.3​


*December 19, 2025*


- Fix an issue where the + button in the bottom right corner fails to upload files.
- Fix an issue where users can't share PDF or video files to Heptabase using the share sheet.


## v1.81.4​


*December 18, 2025*


- Add the Gemini 3 Flash and GPT-5.2 models, and remove the Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-5.1 models.
- You can now add a YouTube playlist in the "Research a new topic" window and import all the videos at once.


## v1.81.3​


*December 16, 2025*


- Able to drag a .txt, .md, or .docx file into the Card Library or Whiteboard to add it as a card.
- Able to undo the "Delete card" action on a whiteboard without seeing an empty placeholder.
- When dragging multiple items into a section, the section will now automatically expand to include all the selected items.
- Add a new "Close window" shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + W) to differentiate it from the "Close tab" action.
- Change the "Card info" button to "New chat/Add to chat" in the Card instance's top-right toolbar.
- Fix an issue where the Kanban view doesn't update when adding a new "select" option.
- Fix an issue where the spell check menu could be blocked by the inline editor toolbar.
- Fix an issue where you had to press the delete key twice to completely remove a double quote mark.
- Fix an issue where some published whiteboards can't be accessed.


## v1.81.2​


*December 10, 2025*


- [Heptabase MCP](https://www.reddit.com/r/heptabase/comments/1pjvvoi/heptabase_update_mcp_is_now_in_public_beta/)


- Support uploading .docx files in the "Research a topic" window and the import menu.
- Add "tidy up" and "add to chat" options in the toolbar when you select multiple objects on a whiteboard.
- Improve overall onboarding experiences.
- You can now upgrade to the Premium plan directly in the app without needing to access the Stripe page.
- Keep a version history when editing a card which has no version history.


## v1.81.1​


*December 6, 2025*


- Able to start a new chat to ask AI questions from the top-right toolbar of a video card.
- Fix an issue where opening a to-do item's location from the Inbox could cause an error.
- Fix an issue where pasting long content into the "New research" panel would break the layout.


## v1.81.0​


*December 5, 2025*


- App: Free AI usage for all users
- App: Create new research topic
- App: New onboarding tutorial
- App: Introduce the Premium plan (Please check 👉[Pro and Premium Plans: Pricing & FAQ](http://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/12990121) )
- Able to hover over a PDF card on the whiteboard to start a chat from it.
- Fixed an issue where the navigation links in the table of contents didn’t work in the Journal app.


## v1.80.2​


*December 1, 2025*


- Able to create a new card from a message
- Improve the experience of clicking block links — the card will now open in the side panel.
- Improve the experience of automatically adding context in the AI chat.
- Improve AI error messages and make them clearer.
- Preserve the context preference options (Space and Internet) in the chat.
- Move the "In whiteboard search" button to the whiteboard toolbar.
- Fix an issue where opening or chatting with certain PDF cards could cause the app to crash or lag.


## v1.80.1​


*November 26, 2025*


- Add Claude Opus 4.5 to the AI model list.
- Fix Chat App message input style.


## v1.80.0​


*November 25, 2025*


- Improve the experience of clicking the "New tab" button in the left sidebar.


## v1.79.1​


*November 24, 2025*


- Chat: Ask AI questions using the entire knowledge base as context


- Fix an issue where text can't be selected or highlighted on certain PDF cards.


## v1.78.12​


*November 21, 2025*


- Automatically fetch and import transcript when importing a YouTube video as a video card in the desktop app.
- Add the GPT-5 model back, and remove the GPT-5 Nano and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite models.
- Fix an issue where Google and YouTube searches aren't available in the global search panel.
- Fix an issue where the Cmd/Ctrl + U shortcut for underlining text on a card conflicts with the upload file shortcut on the whiteboard.


## v1.78.11​


*November 20, 2025*


- Fix an issue where video cards can't use YouTube titles when pasting a YouTube video link into the whiteboard.


## v1.78.10​


*November 20, 2025*


- Add the Gemini 3 Pro and GPT-5.1 models, and remove the GPT-5 model.
- Add "Upload files" to the whiteboard toolbar and the contextual (right-click) menu.
- Rearrange the tools in the whiteboard toolbar and move the "in-whiteboard search" button to the top bar.
- Automatically add a video/audio card to the Card Library when a video/audio file is imported to the whiteboard.
- Automatically fill in the title when turning a YouTube video element into a card in the desktop app.
- Automatically add the current whiteboard tab as context when opening the chat right sidebar in the tab.
- Update style of the chat input panel.
- Improve overall sync stability.
- Fix an issue where files under a to-do block could be lost when reassigning it to another date in the Journal.
- Fix an issue where sometimes users are unable to change the page range of a PDF card in a chat.


## v1.78.9​


*November 17, 2025*


- Improve the loading speed when starting a free trial.
- Improve the loading speed during onboarding.
- Fix an issue where cutting and pasting an image could cause errors.
- Fix an issue where some scanned PDFs couldn't be displayed.


## v1.78.8​


*November 14, 2025*


- Fix an issue where PDF files can’t be parsed in the web app.


## v1.78.7​


*November 14, 2025*


- Fix an issue where some users are unable to sign in with Google.


## v1.78.6​


*November 13, 2025*


- Fix an issue where the text color on the sign-in page is incorrect when the user is using dark mode.
- Fix an issue where uploading corrupted files could cause sync problems.
- Fix an issue where users can upload non-video links in the video uploader.
- Fix an issue where the PDF can’t display certain languages.


## v1.78.5​


*November 12, 2025*


- Improve the overall PDF card resolution and performance.
- Fix an issue where sometimes text on a PDF can’t be selected properly in the Windows desktop app.
- Fix an issue where sometimes PDF highlights can’t be displayed properly in the Windows desktop app.
- Fix an issue where sometimes text on the PDF card can't be highlighted correctly when opening it in a popup window.
- Fix an issue where PDF highlights made in other products may not display correctly in Heptabase.
- Fix an issue where content containing a code block could not be pasted into a card.
- Fix an issue where content in a code block sometimes can't be selected or copied properly.


## v1.78.4​


*November 10, 2025*


- Right Sidebar: Display all to-dos of the current whiteboard and card


- Make the model selector in the Chat app easier to use.
- Fix the whiteboard breadcrumb style when the app window is resized to a smaller size.
- Fix the floating menu position issue in the inbox and to-do apps when the sidebar is closed.
- Fix an issue where, in the Highlight app, trying to select highlight content incorrectly draws a selection box.
- Fix an issue where the card's table of contents doesn't update when switching cards.
- Fix an issue where the Notion importer might not work in some situations.
- Fix an issue where the search filter preference was not being saved correctly when the app was closed.
- Improve the experience of automatically generating chat titles with AI.
- Improve the error message when "too many unsynced changes" occur on the desktop version for a better user experience.
- Improve the experience of removing empty cards from the whiteboard.


## v1.78.3​


*November 6, 2025*


- You can now sign in to our desktop and web apps using a verification code.
- Redesign our Mac desktop app installer.
- Able to right-click on a hyperlink to open the webpage in a new tab, in the side panel, or in your default browser.
- Able to` Option/Alt` +` Click`


on a hyperlink to open the web page in the side panel.


## v1.78.2​


*November 3, 2025*


- Fix an issue where certain filter conditions in the custom filter of the card library were not working properly.
- Fix an issue where editing a message in Chat and scrolling away from the editing window would incorrectly exit edit mode.
- Fix an issue where dragging blocks while editing a template can mistakenly create cards on the background whiteboard.
- Fix an issue where, after a user names a chat, it still gets overwritten by the AI-generated name.
- Fix an issue where users can't navigate to a mention link when opening a popup window in a full card tab.
- Fix an issue where, under certain conditions, the tabs in the Tag table may collapse, making it impossible to see the full names.


## v1.78.1​


*October 31, 2025*


- App: Web tab


- Improve the zooming experience for finding objects on whiteboards.
- Fix the "video player configuring error" when embedding YouTube videos.


## v1.77.0​


*October 29, 2025*


- Right Sidebar: AI suggestions for related cards


- Fix an issue where users might not be able to select any AI models in a chat.


## v1.76.3​


*October 27, 2025*


- Fix an issue where deleting a file block doesn't successfully cancel the upload progress.
- Fix an issue where duplicate uploads can occur in certain situations.
- Fix an issue where clicking on an empty area of a section on the whiteboard doesn't correctly cancel the connect tool and return to the select tool.
- Fix an issue where the context menu wouldn’t open when right-clicking on a card on the whiteboard under certain conditions.


## v1.76.2​


*October 25, 2025*


- Fix an issue where clicking a mention link caused incorrect whiteboard navigation.


## v1.76.1​


*October 25, 2025*


- PDF: Click the outline button to copy or add a chapter as context


- Show a "Parse" button on the PDF card on the whiteboard.
- Able to locate highlights on its source PDF card on public whiteboards.
- Able to use` Cmd/Ctrl` +` Option/Shift` +` =`


to open an empty side panel and search for content to add directly.
- Add a side panel button back to the top bar.
- Fix an issue where, when a matching option was found during a search, it didn't appear as the default option under the cursor.
- Able to add area highlights as chat context.


## v1.75.9​


*October 22, 2025*


- Fix an issue where missing images couldn't be restored.
- Fix an issue where some cards show a "The content is corrupted" error.
- Fix an issue where clicking a public whiteboard link within the app didn’t open in a browser correctly.
- Revamp the sign-in dialog in public whiteboards.


## v1.75.8​


*October 21, 2025*


- Able to use` Cmd/Ctrl` +` Option/Shift` +` \\`


to toggle the last used right sidebar.
- Improve the focus mode experience when editing cards.
- Change the name of the "All" filter in the To-do tab to "Today," and add a new "Not Done" filter view.
- Fix an issue where users couldn't enter correct tabs after switching to another tab group.
- Fix an issue where the card editor flickers when drawing a selection box.
- We no longer support deactivating cloud sync. If you’ve already turned off sync and want to reactivate it, please contact support.


## v1.75.7​


*October 16, 2025*


- Fix an issue where adding a video, audio, or image element from a card to the Card Library could cause it to fail to load.
- Fix an issue where the table of contents sidebar fails to load when opening a PDF card in a full tab.


## v1.75.6​


*October 15, 2025*


- Add a focus mode for editing cards on whiteboards.
- Add animations for side pane operations.
- Automatically close left and right sidebars on smaller screens.
- Fix an issue where pasting a card as sync could cause images or other attachments on the card to fail to load.


## Mobile app v1.31.1​


*October 15, 2025*


- Fix an issue where the editor toolbar is hidden behind the keyboard on Android devices.
- Improve the mobile tutorial experience to make it smoother.


## v1.75.5​


*October 15, 2025*


- Change the shortcut to open the side panel from` Cmd/Ctrl` +` Option/Shift` +` \\`


to` Cmd/Ctrl` +` Option/Shift` +` =`


.
- Improve the file deletion logic to prevent redundant files caused by upload failures.
- Fix a bug introduced in v1.75.4 that caused performance issues on Windows devices under certain conditions.
- Fix an issue where PDF highlighting didn't work on Windows and web app.
- Fix an issue where the shortcut to open the side panel will falsely enlarge screen on Windows devices.


## v1.75.4​


*October 13, 2025*


- Add a focus mode for editing journals and cards in the full tab:


- When any sidebar is open, the top bar will be hidden.
- When no sidebar is open, both the top bar and card borders will be hidden.


- Add a drag indicator when opening the card library right sidebar in a whiteboard tab.
- Fix an issue where exporting all data failed to work.


## v1.75.3​


*October 9, 2025*


- Users can now delete a chat if there are no messages from other people in the chat.


## v1.75.2​


*October 9, 2025*


- Fix an issue where uploading large files could cause a blank screen in the desktop app.


## v1.75.1​


*October 8, 2025*


- Improve the layout for small screens.


## v1.75.0​


*October 8, 2025*


- App: Support can chat permission for public link.


- Able to submit a public whiteboard to the[Heptabase Gallery](https://heptabase.com/gallery) from the publish panel.
- Improve onboarding process.
- Improve server stability to reduce issues that prevent users from syncing.
- Fix an issue where the preview of a block is broken in the search results.
- Fix an issue where dragging a mindmap node might accidentally trigger text selection.
- Fix an issue where some users can't access the web app on HarmonyOS devices.
- Fix an issue where users couldn't open web pages in the side panel of the Journal.


## v1.74.4​


*October 5, 2025*


- Fix the issue that prevents the whiteboard location panel from opening on a card tab.


## v1.74.3​


*October 4, 2025*


- PDF: Use "Shift + Click" or drag a box to select multiple parsed blocks.


- Able to change the color of chat and message instances on a whiteboard.
- Add a button in the bottom of the left sidebar that lets you access the Heptabase gallery.
- Move the "Earn rewards" button to the "Help & documentation" menu.
- Onboarding: New default data


## Mobile app v1.31.0​


*October 4, 2025*


- You can now register for a Heptabase account on the web app using a mobile device.
- Redesign a new mobile onboarding process.
- Add new onboarding tutorials for Whiteboard and Task.


## v1.74.2​


*October 2, 2025*


- Add the Claude 4.5 Sonnet model.
- Able to open a web page in the side panel.
- Improve AI error messages and make them clearer.
- Improve the performance of whiteboards with lots of math blocks.
- Fix issues that occur when a PDF card has pages of different sizes.
- Be able to use Cmd/Ctrl + F to search content in the side panel.


## v1.74.1​


*September 27, 2025*


- Fix the issue where the Gemini API key couldn't be validated.
- Add the ability to copy a single parsed PDF block.


## v1.74.0​


*September 25, 2025*


- PDF: Parsing content, images, equations, and tables with OCR.


- You can now add cards from the side panel to the chat right sidebar as context.
- Improve overall search performance for whiteboards.


## v1.73.8​


*September 25, 2025*


- Fix an issue where locally uploaded videos and audios don’t play correctly.


## v1.73.7​


*September 23, 2025*


- Improve overall stability.


## v1.73.6​


*September 22, 2025*


- Fix layout issues with the public whiteboard on mobile web.
- Fix an issue where some tooltips aren't visible on certain screen sizes.
- Fix an issue where incorrect data was imported as the card title when importing PDF files.
- Fix an issue where the sorting rule for the quick access menu on the Whiteboard did not sort items by title.
- Fix an issue where the options at the bottom of the menu aren't visible when creating a tag in card info.


## v1.73.5​


*September 20, 2025*


- Fix the issue where the public whiteboard UI disappeared when opening a card on mobile.
- Fix the issue where the pinch gesture on the mobile whiteboard unexpectedly triggered browser zoom.


## v1.73.4​


*September 19, 2025*


- Improve performance for users with numerous chats.
- Fix the "Error 153" issue that prevented users from watching YouTube videos.
- Fix an issue where data sometimes failed to sync when users collaborated in another's space.
- Add ability to chat directly with the YouTube video element on the whiteboard in the desktop app without adding it as a video card.


## Mobile app v1.30.1.1​


*September 16, 2025*


- Fix an issue where PDF cards couldn't load correctly.
- Improve the loading experience when the network is unstable.


## v1.73.3​


*September 15, 2025*


- Fix an issue where public whiteboards couldn’t be moved on the mobile browsers.
- Fix an issue where links in chats and messages were not clickable on public whiteboards.
- Fix an issue where sync may not work when users migrate the app data using the Mac’s built-in migration tool.


## v1.73.2​


*September 12, 2025*


- Adjust the direction and position of the "Close side panel" icon.
- Improve public whiteboard loading performance.
- Fix an issue where double-clicking a card in a public whiteboard doesn't open the right panel.


## Mobile app v1.30.1​


*September 12, 2025*


- Fix an issue where some Android devices are unable to log in.
- Improve stability and performance when the network is unstable.


## v1.73.1​


*September 10, 2025*


- Fix an issue where ‘Full title for folded cards’ didn't work on public whiteboards.
- Fix an issue where the right sidebar shortcuts didn’t work on card tabs.


## v1.73.0​


*September 8, 2025*


- App: Live public link (Tutorial 👉[How do I publish whiteboards with a public link?](http://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/12121546) )


## v1.72.0​


*September 5, 2025*


- Right Sidebar: New design


- Side Panel: New design


- App: Design system upgrade
- Refine the copy link button design in the whiteboard and card sharing panels.
- Fix an issue where the "Failed to fetch" error appears when restarting the Heptabase app after the device wakes from sleep.
- Fix an issue where the whiteboard context menu conflicts with the tab settings menu.
- Fix a jittering issue when entering the whiteboard.


## Mobile app v1.30.0​


*September 1, 2025*


- New sign-in UI.


## v1.71.2​


*August 25, 2025*


- Fix an issue where importing audio, video, and image cards to a whiteboard could cause an error.
- Fix an issue where published whiteboard links couldn't open correctly on macOS.


## v1.71.1​


*August 25, 2025*


- Fix an issue where opening the right sidebar would cause an error that made the app freeze and become unusable.


## v1.71.0​


*August 25, 2025*


- Chat: Ask AI questions using selected sections as context.


- Reduce minimum section width and height.
- Improve AI error messages and make them clearer.


## Mobile app v1.29.2​


*August 25, 2025*


- Fix an issue where users couldn't open the card library or a card in the right sidebar on the tablet app.


## v1.70.1​


*August 20, 2025*


- Fix an issue where users couldn't zoom the whiteboard using the mouse wheel in the Windows app.
- Fix an issue where the connection button on the card didn't work.


## v1.70.0​


*August 19, 2025*


- Whiteboard: Toolbar


- Onboarding: Complete guiding tour
- Rename “Link to whiteboard” to “Whiteboard shortcut”.
- Add GPT-4.1 model back.
- Fix an issue where using a web app in the browser triggers the previous or next page when using the trackpad.


## v1.69.1​


*August 14, 2025*


- Fix the incorrect background color on the card tab.
- Fix the layout issue with the card library filter.


## v1.69.0​


*August 12, 2025*


- Chat: Ask AI questions using selected PDF cards as context


- Introduce MAX mode for handling longer context.
- Enable giving thumbs up or down to help the Heptabase team improve AI features.
- Enable regenerating AI responses.
- Add GPT-5, GPT-5 Nano, GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, and Claude 4.1 Opus models.
- Remove Claude 4 Opus, GPT-4o Mini, GPT-4.1, o4 Mini, and o3 models.
- Focus on results instead of the "create card" action in the global search panel.
- Allow deleting an empty mindmap node using the backspace key.
- Enable mentioning all collaborators at once.
- Fix an issue where importing a YouTube channel link would cause the app to get stuck in a loop.


## v1.68.0​


*August 4, 2025*


- Chat: Ask AI questions using selected texts as context


- Chat: Ask AI questions using selected images as context


- Fixed that the invitee didn’t receive invite notification in Inbox when someone shares a card.
- Fixed keyboard shortcut conflict on Mac between command+option+\[ or \] and command + \[ or \].


## v1.67.1​


*July 30, 2025*


- Onboarding: New guiding tour


## v1.67.0​


*July 29, 2025*


- Chat: Ask AI questions using selected chats and messages as context


- Add in-whiteboard search support for chats and messages
- Preserve global search filter settings


## v1.66.0​


*July 22, 2025*


- Search: Advanced filter for global search


## v1.65.0​


*July 21, 2025*


- Chat: Add emoji reactions to messages


- Support filtering by card type in the global search.
- Support removing items from the Inbox.
- Support context menu in the Whiteboard list view in collaborative spaces.
- Improved UI/UX for the sign-in flow on desktop.
- Simplified the Inbox UI for cards.
- Simplified the UI for the AI model selector.
- Removed the "Insight" button in the card tab.
- Fixed an issue where searching for messages would sometimes show duplicate results.
- Fixed an issue where using Alt + Click on a tab in the left sidebar would incorrectly trigger the "Save as HTML" menu.


## Mobile app v1.29.0​


*July 21, 2025*


- Improved the sync stability


## v1.64.0​


*July 15, 2025*


- Chat: You can now select multiple whiteboard objects to add them as chat context or start a new chat with them.
- Support the ‘created by’ filter in the global search.
- Improved loading time when entering someone else’s space.
- Enlarged the layout of the global search palette.
- Rearranged the order of items in the whiteboard context menu (right-click menu).


## v1.63.0​


*July 11, 2025*


- Chat: Ask AI questions using selected whiteboards as context


- Chat - Get reference links from the AI response


- Double-click a chat preview to open the tab and chat sidebar.
- You can now resize columns in the Chat app.
- You can now sort results by relevance or time in the search results window.
- Sort cards in the Chat app by the latest message time.
- Remember the collapsed state of the whiteboard list in the Chat app.


## v1.62.0​


*July 9, 2025*


v1.62.0


- Show the chain of thought for reasoning models in AI chat.
- Able to add a sub-whiteboard in the whiteboard list view
- Able to rename a whiteboard in the whiteboard list view
- Able to rename a sub whiteboard in the whiteboard tab.


## Mobile App v1.28.1​


*July 9, 2025*


- Improved the sync stability


## v1.61.0​


*July 7, 2025*


- Support searching for chats and chat messages in the global search.


## v1.60.2​


*July 5, 2025*


- Fixed global search functionality issue.


## v1.60.1​


*July 5, 2025*


- Improve overall performance.
- Add the 'Copy link' section to share panels.
- 'Find a chat…' now only searches chat titles, no longer includes chat messages.
- Fixed inbox item count to match actual items when in someone else's space.
- Add "Mark as unread" feature.
- Action items marked as done will now return to the "Now" group when added again.
- Fixed logic for the unread message divider.


## v1.60.0​


*July 1, 2025*


- Support global search in collaborative spaces.
- Add error messages for situations where OpenAI models are sometimes unable to function.
- Fixed an issue where Gemini Pro 2.5 was sometimes unusable.
- Fixed an issue where opening a deep link to a chat or message might not work.


## v1.59.0​


*June 25, 2025*


- Chat: Ask AI questions using selected non-PDF cards as context


- Chat: Chat with collaborators and extract messages on a whiteboard


- Inbox: Receive notifications from messages that mention or reply to you


- Improve the sync and reconnection experience when collaborating in someone else’s space.
- Display the notification badge in browser tabs upon any unread Inbox items.
- Support renaming function in whiteboard app list view.
- Support integration with Hookmark.
- Fixed that 'Create by' filter is not working with journals in Card Library on the web app.
- Fixed an issue that data failed to load from a local backup when cloud sync was deactivated.


## Mobile App v1.28.0​


*June 25, 2025*


- Support showing chats and messages on a whiteboard.


## v1.58.3​


*June 17, 2025*


- Show the tab title in both the browser and desktop app.
- Fixed an issue where YouTube captions couldn't be downloaded or imported.
- Fixed an issue where emoji can’t be rendered properly in space and account profile avatars.
- Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would change to the scroll wheel arrow on Windows devices.


## v1.58.2​


*June 10, 2025*


- Display the tab name on browser tabs.
- Fixed styling issues in Inbox.


## v1.58.1​


*June 10, 2025*


- Improved a performance issue that occurs when users have a lot of tags.
- Display the view-only indicator for view-only cards and whiteboard.
- Add a share button into the whiteboard menu.
- Fixed an issue where some users couldn’t use the single card sharing feature.
- Fixed an issue where the ‘createdBy’ filter is not working properly with custom filters.


## v1.58.0​


*June 6, 2025*


- Inbox: Unify quick capture, reminders, and to-dos. (The original Task app is now part of the new Inbox app)


- Collaboration: Support sharing a single card with all types of permissions.


- Allow collaborators to assign todo date on a card.
- Allow collaborators to see the sharing panel even if they only have Can View permission.


## v1.57.2​


*June 4, 2025*


- Fixed an issue where the task app tutorial was missing.


## v1.57.1​


*June 4, 2025*


- Rename Map to Whiteboard
- Show ‘Open in the desktop app?’ conditionally. Now when users open[https://app.heptabase.com](https://app.heptabase.com/) , ‘Open in the desktop app?’ won’t show up
- Fixed an issue where free users couldn't directly access whiteboards when clicking invitation links
- Fixed the issue that opening a published whiteboard link in the browser redirects to the desktop app


## Mobile App v1.27.3​


*June 4, 2025*


- Improve file uploading stability.


## v1.57.0​


*May 16, 2025*


- Collaboration: Support Can View and Can Edit permissions for whiteboards. (Tutorial 👉[Collaboration Q&A](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10510497) )


## v1.56.2​


*May 13, 2025*


- Improve file upload performance.
- Fixed a sync failure issue with area highlight images.


## v1.56.1​


*May 9, 2025*


- Fixed an issue where Readwise wasn't syncing on the web app.
- Fixed an issue where clicking on section links caused strange navigation animations.


## v1.56.0​
